change: Reuse the module-scoped en-US compact number formatter for context and session footers.

method.baseline: git archive of baselineCommit with local node_modules symlinked; generated files are not edited.
method.execution: Each scenario runs in four separate processes in baseline, modified, modified, baseline order. No local test or build commands run during measurement. Other desktop activity remains uncontrolled.
method.warmup: One iterations-sized batch before measurement for each process.
method.samples: Nine timed samples per process; combined medians use eighteen samples for each version.
method.footerFixtures: Four context capacities (1K, 128K, 475K, 1M), all three languages, real preferred and fallback session footer construction, and unknown-capacity control.
method.controls: Unknown-capacity footer and unchanged sentence/paragraph/unbroken text splitter workloads.
method.equivalence: All six scenarios assert matching baseline and modified full-output SHA-256 fingerprints. Splitter also asserts exact reconstruction, bounded chunks and intact surrogate pairs.
method.hashes: sourceHash is SHA-256 of raw source bytes; output fingerprints are SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(output).

claims.controlInterpretation: Unknown-capacity time differs by less than 1%; unchanged splitters vary between 3% faster and 8% slower. No speedup or regression attribution is made for those paths.

invariants: Changing capacities with one shared formatter
Host plugin load and polling disposal
verification.docs: No command, configuration, copy or user-visible behavior changes; README translations require no change.

scopeLimits: Local CPU formatting microbenchmark; no measured real Telegram/model latency.
Absolute complete-footer CPU savings are about 15 microseconds per render in this fixture.
Import-time startup cost and production traffic were not benchmarked.
No persistent state, dependency, protocol or cache-lifetime changes.

discardedExperiment.change: Replace Array.from/filter/map over sentence segments with a single for-of loop.
discardedExperiment.outcome: Reverted because initial paired runs showed no stable useful improvement. The final splitter implementation is unchanged.
discardedExperiment.sourceHashEncoding: These earlier sourceHash fields hash JSON.stringify(source text), rather than raw source bytes.

earlierMixedScenarioRuns.reasonForIsolatedRerun: Mixed runs showed substantial control timing variability during concurrent desktop activity, so final claims use per-scenario processes.
